The '''Step of Harmony''' was an outcropping on the mountain [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] that was used for capital punishment. Individuals who disrupted society were made to step off of the Step of Harmony and plunge to their [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. Many Voss chose to jump off.
